singular VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: singular registry COMMAND

Create a registry and act on it

The registry commands name a registry by its address, which create prints: one
word that holds the registry's state token and its network, so a command given
it needs nothing else to find the registry. Every command but create takes it
from --registry or from SINGULAR_REGISTRY. A registry may still be named by
its state token (--state-token or SINGULAR_STATE_TOKEN) with the network
(--network-magic); given both, they must agree.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

Available commands:
  create    Boot a registry, or preview its identity      
  fold      Fold the pending requests into the registry   
  reject    Reject all pending requests past their windows
  reclaim   Take back your own pending request            
  inspect   Read the registry and a key back
